article.title: Copilotforce連接Salesforce與Microsoft，功能分階段開放
article.summary: Microsoft與Salesforce公布Copilotforce合作，把客戶資料和銷售工作流程接入Copilot、Teams與Fabric。
highlights: Salesforce in Copilot已進入公開預覽，Sales Cloud in Teams仍處於企業試點。
OneLake至Data 360的資料聯邦查詢正式可用，反向分享仍為公開預覽。
article.why: 使用兩套系統的行銷與業務團隊，可先確認哪些資料可查詢，哪些客戶記錄可由使用者確認後更新。
article.next_step: 選一個由行銷轉交業務的流程，核對查詢權限、欄位及更新前的確認步驟。
article.detail: 雙方表示，Copilot可取得經驗證授權的Salesforce資料，並依原有權限執行支援的動作。公告把會後跟進草稿、商機檢視和資料查詢列為使用情境。寫回客戶管理系統須獲使用者明確確認，並符合原有驗證規則。不同整合的推出階段各異，團隊可按現時已取得的功能安排試點。
article.title_en: Copilotforce connects Salesforce and Microsoft through staged releases
article.summary_en: Microsoft and Salesforce announced Copilotforce to connect customer context and sales workflows with Copilot, Teams and Fabric.
highlights_en: Salesforce in Copilot is in public preview. Sales Cloud in Teams remains in an enterprise pilot.
OneLake-to-Data 360 federation is generally available, while sharing in the other direction is in public preview.
article.why_en: Marketing and sales teams can identify what they may query and which customer records they can update after user confirmation.
article.next_step_en: Map one marketing-to-sales handoff and check query permissions, fields and confirmation before updates.
article.detail_en: The companies say authenticated Salesforce access preserves existing permissions. Examples include follow-up drafts, opportunity reviews and data queries. Supported CRM writebacks require explicit user confirmation and existing validation rules. Teams can design a pilot around the components they can access at their current release stage.
